Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Bridging renewal timing for GitHub / JetBrains / Atlassian

Hi Emily / Tom / Rachel —

Quick context: our engineering tool subscriptions are currently spread across three renewal windows (May, Aug, Oct) which creates repetitive procurement work and preview cost spikes. We're evaluating a one-time smoothing run to align renewals into a single window for 2028 and would like pricing/contract flexibility inputs from each vendor so we can present a consolidated ask to Finance and Legal.

Goal for this thread: gather short answers on (1) ability to shift renewal date with prorated billing or credit, (2) minimum notice / amendment process, and (3) any pricing impact for moving term lengths. If you have standard documentation/templates for date-alignment amendments, please attach.

High-level numbers: ~420 GHE seats (org-wide), ~160 JetBrains active licenses, ~220 Atlassian Confluence + Jira licenses. We may propose a 12-month offset for one vendor (short-term proration) or negotiate a 15-month bridging term — open to recommendations.

Can each of you confirm the process/limits by EOD Wednesday PT? Procurement will need a sample amendment to review.

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Developer Productivity
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none on this message
From: Rachel Lin <rachel.lin@github.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Bridging renewal timing for GitHub / JetBrains / Atlassian

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the clear ask. GitHub can support a renewal date change via a pro-rated invoice or a short bridging term. High-level:
- Proration: We can issue a credit for unused months and invoice a new 12-month term starting your chosen date.
- Amendment timeline: typically 2-3 business days for standard orgs; legal review may add time for enterprise contracts.
- Pricing: No base price increase for a single alignment event; multi-year discounts would follow our existing table.

I've attached a sample amendment we use for date changes and a preliminary quote for your 420 seats (GHE_quote_2027_Q2.xlsx). I copied procurement-friendly line items to make review easier.

If helpful I can schedule a 30-minute call with our renewal specialist this week.

Best,
Rachel Lin
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
GitHub

- GHE_quote_2027_Q2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)
From: Emily Park <emily.park@jetbrains-sales.com>

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Bridging renewal timing for GitHub / JetBrains / Atlassian

Sean / Karthik —

We can support alignment but there are two paths: (A) short prorate to the new date (one-off credit + invoice) or (B) extend current term to overlap (15-month bridging) which avoids multiple invoices but requires an amendment signature. JetBrains has a standard amendment template; I'll share it in the next message.

Notes:
- For JetBrains All Products Pack, moving the renewal window is commonly done once per customer in a year without pricing changes.
- Any seat count decreases during the bridging period are credited at renewal, not mid-term.

I'll follow up with the amendment PDF and an example cost calc.

Cheers,
Emily Park
Enterprise Partnerships, JetBrains

Legal/Procurement checklist before we ask vendors to amend:
- Confirm vendor amendment template (we prefer an exhibit with term dates and proration schedule).
- PO vs contract amendment: for GitHub we need both the amendment and a PO for the new invoice window.
- Finance needs the consolidated cashflow impact (month-by-month) — please include in the proposal.

Karthik: can you produce a one-page impact summary (cost delta by month) and drop it in the Drive link Rachel and Sean referenced? Target EOD Friday so I can loop in AP and Legal next week.

All —

Thanks for the quick turn. Karthik: attached is the first-pass consolidation proposal (Redwood_Renewal_Consolidation_Proposal_v1.pdf) with the month-by-month cashflow and two tactical approaches: (1) prorate-to-align (least legal friction) and (2) 15-month bridging term (cleaner single-cycle renewal).

Requesting vendor confirmation on which approach you prefer and the required amendment templates by next Tuesday so Procurement can prepare the combined PO and Legal can run a single review.

If vendors prefer, we can pilot the alignment with GitHub for Q2 (they already supplied a sample amendment) and roll JetBrains/Atlassian into the same window in Q4. Callouts in the PDF: seat counts, expected headcount growth, and an ask for any one-time alignment credits.
